invariants.G02-INV-ATOMIC-RAMP: a change is one ramp; a new target retargets from the current applied gain with no restart or reversal
invariants.G02-INV-AUTHORITY: stale, undeclared and conflicting commands are refused with nothing changed; an epoch is never adopted from a command
invariants.G02-INV-BOUND-BEFORE-RAMP: the target handed to the ramp never exceeds its ceilings, so the applied gain never exceeds them
invariants.G02-INV-GAIN-COMPOSITION: the target gain is min(volume/100 * trim/1000, protection ceiling, fault ceiling), exact in f32
invariants.G02-INV-IDEMPOTENT-RETRY: a replay of the last command is a duplicate and a relative command is applied exactly once
invariants.G02-INV-MISSING-MEMBERS: absent members are skipped and rejoin from a fresh snapshot; unknown and duplicate members are refused
invariants.G02-INV-MUTE-PRIORITY: mute wins over every volume command, including one in flight; each mute reason has one owner
invariants.G02-INV-OVERFLOW: volume, trim and steps saturate or are refused at the type extremes; nothing wraps
invariants.G02-INV-RECONNECT-SILENT: a rejoining or restored member is silent, holds the group's current volume and ramps up from silence
invariants.G02-INV-REJOIN-KEEPS-OWN: a rejoin never restores a volume older than the member's own state, and never undoes a local mute, a fault mute or a fault ceiling
invariants.G02-INV-ROLES: stereo, left, right and sub map onto the admitted layout; a role the board lacks is refused by name
invariants.G02-INV-UI-VIEW: the desired volume, the bounded target and the applied gain are reported separately, with the effective mute reason

cases.title: no ceiling beyond unity: volume x trim, boost clamped at 1
protection ceiling 0.5 clamps the product
fault ceiling 0.3 lowers it further
a fault ceiling above the protection ceiling never raises the bound
a NaN protection ceiling fails closed
an infinite protection ceiling fails closed
a NaN fault ceiling fails closed
S5 has tweeters, mids and a woofer: stereo/left/right yes, sub refused
S3 supports stereo/left/right, sub refused
S1 supports stereo/left/right, sub refused
S9 (9 array channels) supports stereo/left/right, sub refused
the Sub is sub-only: stereo/left/right refused
the Bridge has no audio output: every role refused by that name
a routing list shorter than the channel count is an invalid layout
a subwoofer mixed with other drivers cannot be given a role by an input remap
zero channels with a non-empty routing list is still no audio output
a non-zero channel count with no routing is no audio output
two subwoofer paths are still sub-only
role remap on dyadic samples, including full scale and silence
an asymmetric pair shows left, right and the mono mix are all different
volume x trim above the ceiling is bounded before the ramp, and the ramp ends exactly on the bound
a new target mid-ramp continues from the current gain: up, then up further, then down, never restarting
mute wins over volume commands that arrive while the ramp is running, and unmute ramps up from silence
each mute reason has one owner: a group unmute cannot clear local or fault, and the reported reason follows priority
on a fail-muted board a requested unmute is overridden by the fault and the output stays silent
the identical commands on an active board are audible (the permitted behaviour paired with the refusal above)
stale revision, stale epoch and undeclared epoch are refused with nothing changed; the next legitimate command works
a member with no declared epoch has no authority and refuses every command, then works once declared
retries are idempotent: three replays of a relative command apply it once; a changed payload is a conflict
saturation and overflow: the ends hold, out-of-range payloads are refused without consuming the revision
trim survives group volume changes until reset; local buttons clamp, refuse extremes and never unmute
a live member that rejoins a quieter group ramps to silence first and never exceeds the group's volume
a restarted member holds a stale loud volume but stays silent until it rejoins, then reaches only the group's volume
a restored local mute survives the restart and the rejoin
a restored member with no rejoin accepts no command and its stored volume produces no gain
a reconnect snapshot from an older epoch or with an invalid volume changes nothing; a group mute snapshot is honoured
protection and fault ceilings: the tighter one wins, removing the fault ceiling restores the other, non-finite fails closed
a board that stops being Active fault-mutes the member and only its return to Active restores the stored volume
a rejoin keeps the room's own mute and trim while replacing the volume with the group's
a snapshot older than what the member has applied is refused with nothing changed, a retry stays a duplicate, and an equal or newer snapshot is taken
a newer epoch's snapshot is taken at any revision and an older epoch's is refused at any revision
a rejoin cannot clear a fault mute, the join cannot, a group unmute cannot; the board returning to Active does, and leaves the room's own mute
a rejoin keeps the fault ceiling: the ramp fades out, comes back to the ceiling and not the group's volume, and only removing it goes higher
a restarted member rejoining on a fail-muted board stays silent and does not arm the stored volume (the same steps as G02-MBR-013 on a board that is not Active)
an absent member misses commands, rejoins with the group's current volume, and a retry changes nothing
a per-room command is refused at the group level without consuming its revision
members validate independently: one told about a newer epoch refuses the old one
unknown and duplicate members are refused by name, and a late member holds the group's current volume
a group mute issued while a member was away reaches it through the rejoin snapshot
a group unmute cannot clear a room's own mute
